feature.description: Generate a minimal backend feature library at libs/backend/features/<name>.

entity.description: Generate a Mongo-backed backend entity library at libs/backend/features/<name>, with an optional REST controller (--crud) and an optional shared contract + lazy frontend feature (--frontend).

mongo.description: Install the optional Mongo brick: connects libs/backend/database/mongo to the API app.

auth.description: Install the optional JWT auth brick: connects libs/backend/auth to the API app.

security.description: Install the optional HTTP security brick (Helmet, CORS, rate limiting) into the API app.

mailer.description: Install the optional transactional-email brick (console transport by default, SMTP via SMTP_URL) into the API app.

auth-reset.description: Install the password-reset + email-verification brick (needs the auth and mailer bricks). Wires the /forgot-password + /reset-password + /verify-email routes and the verify-email banner.

health.description: Install the optional liveness healthcheck (GET /health/live) into the API app.

frontend-design.description: Install the frontend design brick: Angular Material + CDK, the M3 theme and the brand charter, wired into apps/frontend.

frontend-i18n.description: Install the frontend i18n brick (V2.3 step 47): Transloco with en/fr bundled, provideI18n() wired into app.config.ts and the <lib-lang-switcher> in the shell toolbar. Needs the design brick.

frontend-auth.description: Install the frontend auth brick: session store, HTTP interceptors, route guards and the /login + /auth/callback routes. Pass --profile to also add the /app/profile page. Needs the design + i18n bricks.

frontend-dashboard.description: Install the dashboard shell brick: responsive MatSidenav layout, config-driven menu, and the /app/** route group behind authGuard.

frontend-feedback.description: Install the feedback brick: DialogService, NotificationService and the ApiError -> toast HTTP interceptor.

frontend-consent.description: Install the consent brick: first-visit cookie banner, preferences dialog, /legal routes (cookie policy, privacy notice, legal notice) with page templates, and the always-visible legal-links footer.

frontend-feature.description: Generate a lazy-loaded business feature under the /app shell (signals store, typed HTTP service, list + detail pages), wired via loadChildren + a DASHBOARD_NAV entry.

frontend-admin-users.description: Replace the /app/admin placeholder with the user admin console (paginated list, role toggles, enable/disable). Needs the dashboard + feedback bricks.

role.description: Install the role-management brick (V2.2 step 44): a Role catalogue with an admin-only CRUD and the /app/admin/roles console. Needs the auth + user bricks.

audit.description: Install the audit-log brick (V2.3 step 45): an append-only audit_events collection filled from auth/user events, a read-only GET /api/audit and the /app/admin/audit console. Needs the auth brick.

docker.description: Add Docker packaging: multi-stage Dockerfiles for the API and the SPA (nginx), plus a docker-compose.yml wiring both to mongo:7.
